title: [S1-1] Adopt Altimetrik UI styling
details:
* Put the Altimetrik brand tokens (colors, typography, radius, spacing) in public/styles/tokens.css.
* Add the logo to the header (`.brand` in public/index.html).
* Restyle the KPI cards, table, chart bars and badges using tokens only, and remove every `FIXME(S1-1)` hard-coded color.
* Acceptance: no hex or `rgb()` colors outside `tokens.css`; WCAG AA contrast; the layout still works at 1280px.
